UN General Assembly Continues with Key Speeches and AI Discussions

The United Nations General Assembly entered its second day in New York with a schedule of significant speeches and discussions. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy are slated to address the assembly. Additionally, prominent figures in artificial intelligence are scheduled to speak at the UN Security Council. Meanwhile, Russia reportedly attacked Kyiv with drones, resulting in two fatalities and 23 injuries, hours before Zelenskyy's address at the UN.
